{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for TIC-80 fantasy console: full console capabilities, conversational code, music, map, and sprite generation by LLM, with native & live web execution.","id":"gh:1369728698","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-tic80","slug":"NoodleStormno/dsh-plugin-tic80","topics":["cordis-plugin","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","fantasy-console","gamedev","tic-80"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for TIC-80 fantasy console: full console capabilities, conversational "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"code, music, map, and sprite generation by LLM, with native & live web execution."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-tic80"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文文档 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**dsh-plugin-tic80** is a full-featured **TIC-80 fantasy computer plugin** engineered specifically f"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"or **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)**. Explore more ecosystem plugins under the `dsh-plugin` topic."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It preserves 100% of TIC-80's official console capabilities while enabling conversational AI workflo"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ws where LLM agents can write **game code, tracker music, world maps, sound effects, and sprite pixe"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"l art**, running and testing games with live hot-reload in real-time."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### ⚡ Built for Rapid Prototyping"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- 🎯 **Instant Game Prototyping**: Designed specifically for fast gameplay iteration and mechanic tes"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ting. Go from a natural language prompt to a playable, fully-featured retro game in seconds.
- ⚙️ **"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"Config-Driven Game Feel Tuning**: Adheres to strict coding conventions where all tunable gameplay va"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"riables (such as jump impulse `jump`, `gravity`, movement `speed`, `friction`) are grouped into a co"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"nfiguration table (`cfg = { ... }`) right at the **very top of the code**. Effortlessly tweak platfo"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"rming feel and physics without digging through complex game loops!
- 🗺️ **WYSIWYG Level Design with "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"Map Editor**: Avoid hardcoding massive 2D level tables in Lua. Design and edit levels directly with "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"TIC-80's built-in **Map Editor (`F3`)**. Powered by Sprite Flags for solid collision and dynamic ent"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ity parsing, level construction is completely "What You See Is What You Get"."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 🌟 Key Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- 🎮 **Full TIC-80 Capabilities**:
- 240×136 retro resolution, 16-color customizable palette.
- Compl"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ete dual-bank architecture: Bank 0 (256 background Tiles) + Bank 1 (256 foreground Sprites), support"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ing multi-tile sprites (16×16, 24×24, 32×32) and 8-bit collision/interaction flags.
- 240×136 world "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"map (32,640 tiles total).
- 4-channel chiptune tracker (64 patterns, 64 tracks, tempo & speed contro"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ls).
- 64 sound effects (SFX) with 30-note envelopes, arpeggios, and 16 custom waveforms.
- Lossless"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" bidirectional conversion between `.lua` text carts and official `.tic` binary ROMs.
- 💬 **Conversat"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ional Game Development**:
- Exposes 13 typed model tools (`dsh-tools`), allowing LLMs to design leve"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"l maps, write Lua scripts, generate ASCII pixel art, synthesize retro sound effects, and arrange mus"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ic through natural language.
- Built-in static Linter checking Lua syntax, `TIC()` entrypoint, 512KB"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" memory budget, and sandbox safety.
- 🚀 **Embedded Web UI & Real-Time Hot-Reload**:
- **DSH Embedded"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" 3-Column Studio**: TIC-80 virtual game console is embedded directly into the DeepSeek Harness Web U"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"I (Left: DSH sidebar, **Middle: TIC-80 Console Screen**, Right: AI Chat), providing an all-in-one ga"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"me dev environment.
- **Turn-1 Ready Blank Cartridge**: Pre-seeded with `cartridge/game.lua` and ful"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ly injected into the System Prompt. The LLM starts generating game logic and assets in Turn 1 withou"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"t wasting turns re-creating cartridges.
- **Official TIC-80 WebAssembly Engine & Studio**: Powered b"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"y the genuine official TIC-80 WebAssembly console (Emscripten / SDL2). Preserves the authentic retro"},{"id":"p9s17","text":" CRT interface style, complete CLI command terminal, and built-in F1-F5 sub-editors (`F1` Code, `F2`"},{"id":"p9s18","text":" Sprites, `F3` World Map, `F4` SFX, `F5` Music Tracker, `Ctrl+R` Run, `Esc` Console).
- **Live Web H"},{"id":"p9s19","text":"ot-Reload**: Real-time WebSocket synchronization. Tool edits made by the LLM update the middle-colum"},{"id":"p9s20","text":"n TIC-80 screen immediately.
- **Native Desktop Runner**: Headless CLI execution and desktop window "},{"id":"p9s21","text":"integration with official `tic80.exe`.
- 📦 **Multi-format Exporters**:
- One-click export to `.lua` "},{"id":"p9s22","text":"source carts, `.tic` binary ROMs, and standalone playable `.html` web games.
- 🕹️ **Pre-built Templa"},{"id":"p9s23","text":"tes**:
- `minimal`, `platformer`, `sokoban`, `rpg`, and `shmup`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 📦 Installation & Setup"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Using in DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Add the plugin to your `cordis.yml` or `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Launch via dsh CLI:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Standalone Usage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 🛠️ DSH Tools Overview"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Tool Name | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `tic80_init` | Initialize a cartridge project from gen"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"re templates |
| `tic80_get_cart` | Inspect cartridge code, sprites, map regions, or audio state |
|"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" `tic80_set_code` | Update game code (Lua/JS) with validation and hot-reload |
| `tic80_edit_sprite`"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" | Draw 8×8 or multi-tile sprites using ASCII art (e.g. `.` transparent, `0`-`f` colors) |
| `tic80_"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"batch_sprites` | Batch define animation frames and tilesets |
| `tic80_edit_map` | Place tiles, fill"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" areas, or load ASCII map diagrams on the 240×136 grid |
| `tic80_create_sfx` | Synthesize sound eff"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ects using presets (jump/coin/laser/etc.) or custom notes |
| `tic80_compose_music` | Compose 4-chan"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"nel retro chiptune patterns and chain into tracks |
| `tic80_set_palette` | Switch 16-color palettes"},{"id":"p20s9","text":" (Sweetie-16, PICO-8, DB16, GameBoy, Cyberpunk) |
| `tic80_validate` | Perform static checks on cart"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"ridge limits, syntax, and API usage |
| `tic80_run` | Launch Web Live Studio (with live hot reload) "},{"id":"p20s11","text":"or native `tic80.exe` |
| `tic80_export` | Export cartridge as `.lua`, `.tic`, or standalone `.html`"},{"id":"p20s12","text":" |
| `tic80_studio_status` | Query live studio status, connected players, and logs |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 🧪 Automated Testing"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Run the full test suite (100% passing across all modules):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## 📄 License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"MIT License © 2026 NoodleStormno"}],"truncated":false}
